The breakthrough means that unseen . bystanders who witnessed a crime could now be identified once the . high-resolution photographs are magnified. Psychologists . at the University of York and the University of Glasgow were able to . extract such images and zoom in on them so that the subjects could be . identified by third parties. Lead . researcher Dr Rob Jenkins said: ‘The pupil of the eye is like a black . mirror. Eyes in the photographs could reveal where you were and who you . were with.' Identifiable: The faces of individuals in the photograph can be seen by zooming in on the image .
